recognize_zh: 剖半的大型實質腫塊，切面呈灰褐色、質地均勻，中央散在黃白色砂粒狀鈣化區與暗褐色出血灶；以縱膈腔孤立大腫塊的臨床背景，這種帶鈣化的切面符合 Castleman 病（hyaline-vascular 型常見中央鈣化）。
features: Bivalved, well-circumscribed, lobulated solid mass with a thin capsule-like rim
Homogeneous tan-gray, fleshy to firm cut surface
Central gritty yellow-white areas suggestive of calcification/ossification
Scattered dark brown-purple foci consistent with hemorrhage
No obvious necrotic cavitation or cystic change visible
describe_en: Gross photograph of a bivalved, well-circumscribed lobulated mass. The cut surface is predominantly firm and tan-gray, with central gritty yellow-white areas suggestive of calcification or ossification and scattered dark brown foci of hemorrhage. No cystic change or grossly obvious necrosis is seen. The gross appearance is nonspecific but, in the context of a solitary mediastinal mass, is compatible with unicentric Castleman disease; histologic examination is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Thymoma typically shows lobules separated by white fibrous septa on cut surface, and histology shows epithelial cells with immature T cells rather than regressed follicles with hyalinized vessels.
Nodular sclerosis CHL shows broad fibrous bands dividing nodules and histology reveals Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are absent in Castleman disease.
Teratoma shows cystic spaces, hair, sebaceous material or cartilage/bone on gross, whereas Castleman disease is a solid lymphoid mass with only focal calcification.
Solitary fibrous tumor has a whorled white fibrous cut surface and STAT6-positive spindle cells histologically, unlike the lymphoid follicular architecture of Castleman disease.
